# Unisend
A Matrix client for Android and the Linux desktop.
-# version 0.1.0
Any homeserver works. A Beeper account adds its bridges, so WhatsApp, Signal, Messenger, Instagram and Telegram land in the same list.

items.description: Unisend on desktop: the chat list beside a group chat with a shared photo, a reply, reactions and a poll
The chat list on a phone
A group chat on a phone: a photo, a reply, reactions, a poll
Appearance settings on a phone: theme, language, chat colour and text size

components.content: -# Taken from the app, with made-up chats. Nobody real is in them.

### What it does
- Replies, reactions, edits, polls, Markdown as you type
- End-to-end encryption; verify a device by comparing emoji
- Search across every chat, in a local index on the device
- Messages wait in a queue that survives losing signal and restarting the app
- App lock with the phone's lock or an app PIN; screenshots blocked on Android
- No push service: on Android the app keeps its own connection to your homeserver

### Where it runs
```
Android   main target, tested on a phone
Linux     built and tested
macOS     in progress
Windows   compiles, never run
```
-# No telemetry, no crash reports, no Google services. 52,422 lines of Rust, 359 tests, 826 strings in Polish.
